newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber closes limit up on key Sept contract.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber closes limit up on key Sept contract.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed the $10 per thousand board feet limit up on the key September contract boosted by commercial buying and light fund short covering, dealers said.
A Canadian holiday kept conditions thin and limited selling interest. "At least half the natural sellers are on holiday," one dealer said.
They noted R.B. and H. Financial Services and Cargill Investor Services were featured buyers of September. The pool of unfilled buy-orders against September was estimated at a light 15 lots.
Cash trade was slow. Last week's Slocan Forest Products Ltd announcement they would be taking mills down for one-week down time remained a background supportive influence.
September ended the $10 limit up at $356.90 per thousand board feet. Other months were $8.90 to $0.50 higher.
